This supports the proposed count-oriented name; specific field meanings remain unknown.

The stub itself forwards through slot 0x70022ab050; its exact external symbol is not established, so the name remains limited to observed behavior. No indexed caller is available.

No indexed caller is available. Byte offset and access width match the proposal; no structure type is claimed.

The body initializes a temporary collection, obtains its count, loops through indices, and calls the accepted set_global_context_entry_flag_0x78_with_status_13_index_override helper per item (passing a zero override). The surrounding caller invokes this function during context-entry traversal. The name describes the proven action without asserting the hidden collection type.
